# ButtonData Interface

> [!CAUTION]
> This interface is still in pre-release.  Its signature may change or it may be removed in future releases.

Data used to configure a button.

## Properties

### **label**
`label: ObservableString | ObservableUIRawMessage | string | UIRawMessage;`

The text label to display on the button.

Type: [*ObservableString*](ObservableString.md) | [*ObservableUIRawMessage*](ObservableUIRawMessage.md) | *string* | [*UIRawMessage*](UIRawMessage.md)

### **onClick**
`onClick: () => void;`

A callback function that is invoked when the player clicks the button.

Type: () => *void*

### **options**
`options?: ButtonOptions;`
